body:
## Expected Behavior
Pagination must work

## Actual Behavior
Pagination doesn't work we got an error from the method
/api/v1/namespaces/robocall-ru-prod/workflows?pageSize=100...
```
ListWorkflowExecutions failed: elastic: Error 400 (Bad Request): [1:237] [bool] failed to parse field [should] [type=x_content_parse_exception], root causes: [range] query does not support [from] [type=parsing_exception]
```

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem
  1. Click on forward arrow

## Specifications
  - Version2.42.1
  - Platform: k8s
  - Elastic version: 9.1.2
